rows.text: This is a gift deck, and the gifts are poisoned. The Beamtown Bullies hand an opponent a creature out of YOUR graveyard on their own turn — so the deck fills its graveyard with the worst creatures ever printed, the ones whose drawbacks land on whoever controls them. Leveler exiles their library. Eater of Days costs them two turns. Bronze Bombshell sacrifices itself and deals seven to the face. You are not reanimating; you are handing out grenades.

rows.name: The Beamtown Bullies
rows.text: vigilance and haste, and {T} gives an opponent — on THEIR turn — a nonlegendary creature from your graveyard, hasted and goaded, exiled at end step. Vigilance matters: you attack on your turn and still have him untapped for theirs.

Because the target must be "the opponent whose turn it is", you get one activation per opponent per round. Three opponents is three gifts a turn cycle, and each one only needs the Bullies to be untapped.

rows.name: Marvin, Murderous Mimic
rows.text: has all activated abilities of your other creatures, which includes the Bullies' gift ability. Two gifts per player, per round.

rows.name: Magewright's Stone
rows.text: untaps a creature with a tap ability. Another gift on the same turn.

rows.name: Patriar's Seal
rows.text: mana, plus an untap aimed at legendary creatures — the Bullies included.

rows.name: Formidable Speaker
rows.text: tutors a creature on arrival and untaps a permanent every turn afterwards.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: haste and shroud. The Bullies eat removal the moment the table works out what he does.

rows.name: Leveler
rows.text: whoever controls it exiles their entire library. They lose the game on their next draw step. This is the deck's cleanest kill and it costs you one activation.

rows.name: Eater of Days
rows.text: its controller skips their next TWO turns. Handing this to the player about to win is often better than killing anything.

rows.name: Bronze Bombshell
rows.text: any player other than its owner sacrifices it immediately and takes seven damage. You own it, so it always goes off.

rows.name: Inverter of Truth
rows.text: its controller exiles their library and shuffles their graveyard in. Early in a game, that is a very small deck; often it is lethal on its own.

rows.name: Avatar of Woe
rows.text: not a gift — a creature you actually want, and with ten creature cards in graveyards it costs two mana and taps to kill something every turn.

rows.name: Entomb
rows.text: one mana, instant speed, exactly the grenade you need.

rows.name: Buried Alive
rows.text: three at once. Leveler, Eater of Days and Bronze Bombshell is the standard pile.

rows.name: Dina's Guidance
rows.text: a creature to hand OR straight to the graveyard, at instant speed.

rows.name: Hermit Druid
rows.text: reveals until a basic land, and this deck runs very few — so it dumps a huge chunk of your library into the graveyard for one green mana.

rows.name: Oriq Loremage
rows.text: tutors any card directly into your graveyard, every turn.

rows.name: Fauna Shaman
rows.text: converts a creature in hand into the exact creature you want, and the discarded one lands where you want it anyway.

rows.name: Faithless Looting
rows.text: cheap filtering, twice.

rows.name: Bitter Reunion
rows.text: a discard, two cards, and a haste enabler later.

rows.name: Formidable Speaker
rows.text: a discard and a tutor on one body.

guide.title: Getting them back when you want them yourself

rows.name: Animate Dead
rows.text: reanimate on your own side when the board needs a threat rather than a gift.

rows.name: Eternal Witness
rows.text: any card back from the graveyard.

rows.name: Fang, Fearless l'Cie
rows.text: a card and a life whenever cards leave your graveyard — which the Bullies do every single turn, on somebody else's turn.

rows.name: Deathrite Shaman
rows.text: mana, drain and lifegain out of everyone's graveyards.

rows.name: Endurance
rows.text: flash, and it resets a graveyard deck at instant speed — including yours, if someone is about to exile it in response.

rows.name: Deadly Rollick
rows.text: free with your commander out.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat
rows.text: free, and it redirects the removal spell aimed at the Bullies.

rows.name: Bitter Triumph
rows.text: a creature or planeswalker, and the discard cost puts a grenade in the yard.

rows.name: Abrupt Decay
rows.text: uncounterable, for the cheap problem permanent.

rows.name: Assassin's Trophy
rows.text: two mana for any permanent.

rows.name: Heroic Intervention
rows.text: hexproof and indestructible through a wrath.

rows.name: Legolas's Quick Reflexes
rows.text: split second, so it protects the Bullies through anything — and it untaps him for another gift.

rows.name: Pyroblast
rows.text: one mana against the blue deck holding the counterspell.

rows.name: Despotic Scepter
rows.text: destroys a permanent you OWN, which includes a gift that has not gone off yet or a creature an opponent has stolen from you.

rows.name: Birds of Paradise
rows.text: turn-one fixing.

rows.name: Llanowar Elves
rows.text: the green half.

rows.name: Elves of Deep Shadow
rows.text: the black half.

rows.name: Ignoble Hierarch
rows.text: all three colours and exalted.

rows.name: Delighted Halfling
rows.text: uncounterable mana for legendary spells — the Bullies included.

rows.name: Dark Ritual
rows.text: three black on turn one.

rows.name: Nature's Lore
rows.text: an untapped dual.

rows.name: Demonic Tutor
rows.text: any card in the deck.

rows.name: Arcane Signet
rows.text: fixing.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep a graveyard enabler and acceleration. Entomb or Buried Alive plus a mana dork means the Bullies land on turn three with a live grenade already waiting.

Gift on THEIR turn, always — the ability requires it. Activate in their upkeep so the creature is under their control for their whole turn, and remember it is goaded, so it has to attack somebody who is not you.
Pick the target, not the biggest threat. Leveler at the player with the most cards left in library, Eater of Days at whoever is about to take a winning turn, Bronze Bombshell at whoever is lowest.

rows.name: Hermit Druid
rows.text: it is the fastest way to load the graveyard, but it also mills your own answers. Use it when you have a specific grenade in the deck and the Bullies already on the battlefield.
